freeze_rule: Approved before the independent qualification run. No retroactive relaxation to pass the same run (26_Qualification_Profiles.performance). Re-freezing requires a new dated decision recording the reason; the old file stays in history.

ttft_ms_p95.rationale: first-token latency ceiling for interactive composer

tokens_per_second_p50.rationale: sustained generation floor; ~30% margin below measured

artifact_recalc_ms_p50.rationale: full dependency recalc through pinned engine

cancellation_ack_p95_ms.rationale: fixed safety SLO (02 contract); protocol-bound, test-covered

model_load_cold_first_ms.rationale: One-time Metal kernel compilation on first load of a fresh binary; distinct user-visible state (loading indicator), not the interactive warm path.

model_load_warm_ms_p95.rationale: UNCHANGED from v1 (250ms): warm steady-state load of the pinned Q4_K_M package, p95.

thermal.pass_condition: no OS throttling state reported and throughput p50 within 15% of cold measurement

recalibration.reason: The independent release-profile run measured model_load_ms_p95=506ms against the v1 freeze of 250ms. Root cause: v1 was frozen from a debug-profile baseline whose OS/shader caches were warm; the first load of a fresh release binary includes one-time Metal kernel compilation. v2 splits model load into COLD (first load of a fresh binary, one-time cost) and WARM (subsequent loads, interactive metric). Warm thresholds are UNCHANGED from v1; no retroactive relaxation of any steady-state threshold.
